name: PlugNspectr
author: Kevin Jenkins
description: Analyzes the frequency response, harmonic distortion, and dynamics of other audio plugins in your DAW in real time
changes:
This release makes PlugNspectr's measurements trustworthy in more setups: behind plugins that add delay, at large buffer sizes, and when more than one Pre is loaded. It also fixes several readings that could mislead you.

> **Update both plugins together.
